model_codename_zh: 第一型『變速箱自主模型』
instruction: Develop a mutually composable mini-model gearbox with gears 1-6 without interrupting the current mission; new owner input must be caught while existing work keeps rotating until a verified clutch/handoff point.

transmission_semantics.rpm_continuity: Preserve active mission state, pending packet, lease, evidence pointers, route and return condition while owner input is classified.
transmission_semantics.clutch_overlap: Old gear/worker continues the already authorized atomic task while A captures and classifies new input. No state reset. Shift completes only after the receiving gear has enough compact state to continue deterministically.
transmission_semantics.torque_handoff: Transfer compact durable control state rather than raw chat: mission_id, step, current route, pending work, evidence pointer, rollback, blocker, priority, return condition, and state fingerprint.
transmission_semantics.upshift_overlap: G1 remains safety clutch until G2 acknowledges route state; G2 remains route holder until G3/G4 acknowledges specialist state; higher gear never invalidates lower-gear safety control.
transmission_semantics.downshift_overlap: On uncertainty/risk/contradiction, lower gear is engaged before higher-gear autonomy is released; brake/rollback remains available throughout transition.

success_additions: machine-testable gear selection and upshift/downshift rules
at least one shared-base multi-adapter proof or equivalent composable specialist proof
high-risk or low-confidence events downshift to stricter deterministic control instead of escalating autonomy
gear changes are recorded in compact progress state and independently verifiable by LCR-C
incoming owner control during active work does not reset mission RPM/state
a simulated G1->G2 overlap keeps the original atomic task alive until receiver ACK then transfers compact state without duplicate execution
a simulated G2->G1 downshift engages lower-gear guard before higher-gear release
load shedding uses existing B/C or micro-expert gears before considering any new formal window
